t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Red gnomes potentially yield more mushrooms, according to the last player. The last player implied that there is something different about blue gnomes but it isn't clear if this quality is good or bad.

vb_textbox.text: I conducted a test with my 20 practice games, splitting my gnome decision 50/50. I noticed that regardless of colour the gnomes I selected from the righthand side on average return a higher number of mushrooms and a higher total mushrooms found in any single game. 20 games is not a large sample size, so I continued experimenting whilst playing but ultimately came to the conclusion gnomes on the right yielded higher returns. Pick right and try not to miss any rounds!
